decision: a NEW v4 sealed set is required; the v3 set is not reused
reason: the v4 instrument population is five primary instruments — the exact-count rule, the word-length rule and three admitted family verifiers — and the v3 sealed set was composed for the exact-count rule alone, so it cannot exercise the word-length or family verifiers at all
v3_set: stays sealed either way; nothing in dci1v4 can open it
v4_seal: sealed at Gate 1 by dci1v4.stages.gate1.seal_final_check_set, opened at most once after every autorater choice is frozen, never for tuning, never rerun
